## Draggable.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `axis` :: The axis the element can be dragged along.
- `bounds` :: Limits for the drag. `'parent'` keeps the element inside its parent's box.
- `snapBack` :: When true, the element springs back to its rest position on release.
- `momentum` :: When true, release velocity carries the element on before it settles.
- `elastic` :: How far the element may rubber-band past a bound, from 0 to 1.
- `spring` :: The spring used on release and for keyboard movement.
- `handle` :: A CSS selector for a drag handle, or a snippet rendered as the handle. When set, only the handle starts a pointer drag.
- `disabled` :: Turns pointer and keyboard dragging off.
- `position` :: The current offset from rest, in pixels. Two-way bindable.
- `onPositionChange` :: Called when `position` changes, from a drag or from the keyboard.
- `onDragStart` :: Called when a pointer drag starts.
- `onDrag` :: Called as the pointer moves during a drag.
- `onDragEnd` :: Called when a pointer drag ends.
- `children` :: The draggable content.
